description: Execution of the Road Section from Kahathuduwa to Ingiriya, which is the Phase I of the Ruwanpura Expressway, under 11 contract packages
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-07-27 for the construction of the road section from Kahathuduwa (Ch.-1+820km) to Ingiriya (Ch.24+000km), which is the first phase of the Ruwanpura Expressway including the system interchange. Bids have been invited following the national competitive procurement method to select contractors for the implementation of the said phase under 11 contract packages. Based on the recommendations submitted by the High Level Procurement Committee, following the evaluation of the bids received, the proposals made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, and Urban Development to award the said contracts to the substantially responsive bidders as follows, were approved by the Cabinet:
